title: Mona Lisa
description: The Mona Lisa is a half-length portrait painting by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci.
historicalContext: Considered an archetypal masterpiece of the Italian Renaissance.

title: The Starry Night
description: The Starry Night is an oil-on-canvas painting by the Dutch Post-Impressionist painter Vincent van Gogh.
historicalContext: Painted in June 1889, it depicts the view from the east-facing window of his asylum room at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.

title: Water Lilies
description: Water Lilies is a series of approximately 250 oil paintings by French Impressionist Claude Monet.
historicalContext: The paintings depict his flower garden at his home in Giverny.
